locations.title: Haunted House Easter Egg
locations.description: High up on the shelf in the bedroom under the stairs there's an interactable skull.  Interact with it about five times until it spins for a while.  The doors and windows in the house will all shut and two ghosts will attack you.  There's a body in a bathtub and blood on the walls and ceiling on the top floor room.  Opposite that room, is another room you can get out of the house from via the roof.

locations.title: Secret Ending
locations.description:
**Prerequisite:** Main quest [The Gathering](#loc=70447)

**Requires:** [Military Transport Key](#loc=70956), [Nuclear Codes](#loc=70966), [Military Activation Card](#loc=70967)

Open the trailer with the key card, activate the computer inside, and then activate the nuclear device to blow yourself up!  (After the credits roll you'll be transported back to the safe zone)

**Reward:** [Team Dying Light](#loc=70968)

locations.title: Unknown Strange Diagram
locations.description:
**Important:** Quitting the game before this puzzle is complete and the rewards are obtained will reset the puzzle - replacing all unknown strange rocks to their original locations!

Find the glowing diagram in the attic on the floor.  Place 15 of the Unknown Strange Rocks on the diagram and interact with the diagram during the night.  Walk towards the light and watch the cutscene.  You'll be teleported to the location with your reward afterwards.

**Reward:** [Uranophobic Fabaceous Ornithomancer](#loc=71222) and [Uranophobic Fission Cores](#loc=71223)
